issue.title: test_bootstrap_issue_enroll_hello_round_trip_through_real_gateway flakes under full test-cost
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/dispatch/test_machine_bootstrap_real_gateway.py::test_bootstrap_issue_enroll_hello_round_trip_through_real_gateway`
- **Repro:** `just check-full` (test-cost lane) then `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/dispatch/test_machine_bootstrap_real_gateway.py::test_bootstrap_issue_enroll_hello_round_trip_through_real_gateway -q --tb=short`

On 2026-09-19, sase-11l.11 landing monitor pz319b38sapt ran `just fix && just check-full && (cd sase/repos/linked/sase-core && just check)` at SHA 423316a051. test-cost failed this node with `assert status.state == "ok"` (got `"error"`) after enrollment succeeded (quarantined is False, credential present). Immediate isolated rerun on the same unchanged tree passed (1 passed in 7.46s, call 0.44s).

MachineService.status maps several hello/config failures to state `"error"` (missing alias, missing credential, or `hello failed: {code}`); the full-lane traceback did not include `status.message`, so the parallel-lane cause is unconfirmed. Not a hold/pin regression: last touch of this file is d015f48cb0; hold commits do not edit dispatch bootstrap tests. Duplicate searches (node id, real_gateway, enroll_hello, machine bootstrap) found no existing task. Active epic sase-xe.16 still has an open bootstrap-enrollment phase, but that is topical overlap, not a demonstrated causal product gap.

Evidence: file:monitor-stage:test-cost-924070-1789818373189266687-84ef1c63

payload.entry:
Fixed: real-gateway fixture SIGKILLs the process group on teardown (no 5s SIGTERM wait), captures gateway stdout/stderr, and the enroll/hello test retries only when `state == "error"` and `message` starts with `hello failed:`. Alias/credential isolation errors still fail immediately with `status.message` plus gateway logs. Verified:

- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/dispatch/test_machine_bootstrap_real_gateway.py -q --tb=short` (teardown ~0.01s; 4 passed)
- same file plus import-budget under `pytest -n 4`
- `just check` (scoped, passed)

Host stitch for this tale lands the change.

payload.close_reason: Real-gateway teardown SIGKILLs immediately; hello retries only transport failures

evidence.note: Recurred on 2026-09-25 on a tree that already contains the sase-13h fix (master f648e88e4 plus an unrelated ACE header-card diff). just check (monitor y9gc9v3aezt8, sase tool run 945f3a716809a1eed2a035d9e2c5af93) escalated test-scoped to the full lane (11 xdist workers, 47406 items, 23m05s) and this node failed with AssertionError: state='error' message='hello failed: timeout', gateway stdout/stderr both empty. Enrollment itself succeeded (quarantined False, credential present); only the post-enroll hello status kept timing out through the whole _HELLO_RETRY_WINDOW_SECONDS. The same node passed alone on the unchanged tree immediately afterwards (pytest -n0: 2 passed in 13.16s, this node's call 1.16s). So the retry window added by the close does not cover a saturated host: hello times out on every attempt rather than failing once. The change under test touches only ACE header widgets, docs and goldens, nothing in dispatch/machine code.
